STEP-BY-STEP PROCESS Step Instruction Step 1 Confirm COO type with buyer (GSP Form A or non-preferential) — ideally at Quotation/PI stage. Step 2 Cargo packed. Packing List finalised with actuals. CHA files Shipping Bill with customs. Step 3 Shipment booked. Bill of Lading issued by shipping line. Step 4 Complete this preparation sheet — fill Section 2 values from CI, PL, and BL. Step 5 Collect all documents listed in Section 1. Tick each checkbox. Step 6 Submit complete package to CHA — or apply directly on the CAPEXIL portal (www.capexil.com). CHA handles this in most cases. Step 7 CAPEXIL verifies and issues COO — typically 1–3 working days. Step 8 COO received. Include with shipment documents sent to buyer (along with CI, PL, BL). 4. NEXACREST CAPEXIL REGISTRATION DETAILS Prepared By * Name of person completing this sheet RCMC Issuing Body CAPEXIL — Chemicals and Allied Products Export Promotion Council Member Company NexaCrest International Private Limited IEC AAAAA0000A RCMC Number * <REF> RCMC Valid Until * <DATE> CAPEXIL Portal www.capexil.com — COO applications can be submitted online CAPEXIL Office Chennai Regional Office handles granite/stone exporters from Karnataka — confirm with CHA ‼ Annual renewal: RCMC must be renewed annually. If RCMC expires, CAPEXIL cannot issue a COO — your shipment documents will be incomplete and customs clearance will fail. Set a reminder 60 days before expiry.
